name: Smart Divider
author: nikhill-666
description: A theme-aware divider between groups of chips, with five shapes, adjustable size and colour; right-click one to style it or add another.

barWidget.description: A divider between groups of chips. Right-click to pick a shape, size and colour or duplicate, drag to move, drag off the bar to remove.

schema.label: Divider shape
schema.description: Line, dot, oval, square or rounded square. Each divider keeps its own shape; right-clicking one on the bar is the usual way to change it.

schema.label: Width (% of bar height)
schema.description: How thick the mark is. 8 is the original thin rule.

schema.label: Height (% of bar height)
schema.description: How long the mark is. 62 is the original rule; 100 fills the bar.

schema.label: Colour
schema.description: Theme colour, the accent, the bar foreground, or the urgent tone. A custom #rrggbb can be typed in the right-click menu.
